thread:
Anna: quick sync — PM asked for a single 'GPU capacity' card in Console that covers Hosted + Dedicated: SM occupancy, per-host GPU memory %, and queue depth. wants it for next week's exec review. anyone own the metric defs?

Jordan: I can drive the dashboard UX. question: do we want separate series for hosted vs dedicated or a combined view with a pool filter?

Mike: runtime note — SM occupancy currently computed as `active_sm_threads / total_sm_threads` per instance. that gets weird with pinned jobs on Dedicated (they reserve SMs) so raw occupancy underestimates real headroom.

Sophia: infra: ingestion-wise we have `redwood.sm.occupancy` and `redwood.sm.queue_depth` emitted from the agent; host memory is `redwood.gpu.mem_used_pct`. cardinality for Dedicated pool_id can be high but manageable.

Anna: Jordan — filter by pool (hosted,dedicated) + pool_id for drilldown. top-level card should show combined 99/95/50 percentiles across pools and a sparkline.

Jordan: ok. UX suggestion: default to aggregated by pool, with toggle to split. include a small 'rollout risk' band based on occupancy > 85% and queue_depth > 20.

Mike: need to be careful with occupancy semantics. propose we add `redwood.sm.effective_headroom` computed as `available_sm_slots - reserved_sm_slots` to capture pinned-job reservations on Dedicated. we don't currently emit reserved_sm_slots.

Sophia: can add reserved_sm_slots to agent but it might take a week to ship across fleets. short-term we can approximate by using node labels + allocation tables from scheduler to infer reservations. higher latency though.

Kevin: telemetry-bot: deploy pipeline kicked: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/telemetry/2483 (adds new metric flag). :robot_face:

Anna: for alerts, PM wants single alert that fires when combined risk band is high for >5m. But ops wants separate alerts per pool and per region. we need both.

Jordan: draft alert rules:
```
- alert: GPUCapacityHigh_Combined
  expr: max_over_time((redwood.sm.occupancy{env=~"prod"} > 0.85 or redwood.sm.queue_depth > 20)[5m:])
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity="page"}
```
Keep it simple, but include pool label so we can route.

Mike: that expr won't work for Dedicated reservations until we have effective_headroom. For now mark Dedicated alerts as 'experimental' in runbook.

Sophia: also consider metric cardinality explosion if we tag every `pool_id` + `instance_type` + `region`. propose only pool_id + region for dashboards; instance-level metrics go into zoom-in panels.

Anna: rollout plan: 1) add reserved_sm_slots flag to agent (Mike + Sophia) 2) emit effective_headroom metric 3) add dashboard card & alert (Jordan) 4) Canary the alert to Staging then Prod (ops). timeline: aim to soft-launch by EOD Fri.

Mike: I'll prototype reserved_sm_slots in a feature branch today. question: where should we put the prometheus metric name? `redwood.sm.reserved_slots`?

Sophia: sounds good. keep naming consistent with `redwood.sm.*`. we'll need a migration note for grafana queries and for any downstream billing hooks.

Kevin: telemetry-bot: feature branch build passed, test harness shows `redwood.sm.reserved_slots` emitted on canary infra. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/5421 ✅

Jordan: I'll mockup a Console card and put it in /design for review. want the alert action to suggest fallback model routing and canary rollback.

Anna: Ops: can someone own the runbook update? include how to silence combined alert vs pool alert.

Sophia: I'll own the runbook update and add notes about cardinality tradeoffs.

Mike: quick note on sampling: occupancy reported every 10s, queue_depth every 5s, mem_used_pct every 30s. maybe align to 10s for consistency. increasing scrape rate for mem affects ingest cost though.

Jordan: For dashboard latency, we'll precompute 1m and 5m aggregates in the metrics pipeline. Engineering infra: any objections?

Sophia: precomputes ok but need to ensure labels are stable. we'll add a rollout flag to enable the aggregated series.

Anna: sounds good. action items: Mike protos reserved metric (due Today), Sophia enables ingestion flag + runbook (Due Thu), Jordan finishes mockup + alert rule (Due Thu), Ops will run canary (Due Fri). I'll post a summary to #eng-all after lunch.

Kevin: telemetry-bot: canary emits look-good sample: `{pool: "dedicated-east", occupancy: 0.72, reserved_slots: 8}`

Mike: thanks — will push PR in 30m. :thumbsup:

Sophia: FYI — we should also add a small panel comparing hosted vs dedicated p95 latency for inference requests to correlate high occupancy with tail latency.

Anna: agreed. include latency panel as a secondary card. Jordan add to mockup.

Jordan: added. uploading mock: https://design.internal/redwood/dashboards/gpu-capacity-v1.png

Anna: perfect. will sync with PM and ops after canary. thanks everyone. :rocket:
